args.text: Can you put together every open or recent ticket and feature request on Marrow Agrisupply and Marrow Fieldworks? Pull from our team channels and Moss's Central notes, and label each one by account. I need the list for the Marrow review on Thursday.

@hollis.mbeki Here's what I found for Marrow in #central-team and Moss's Central digests. Nothing newer than June in the channel, so check the tracker for current status.

Marrow Agrisupply
- FR-882: feature request for custom pallet-jack icons on the Pemberline Dock yard map for seasonal fertilizer sheds. Routed to the product backlog for Q2 review (Moss digest, 2 Jan 2026). Status after that not in my sources.
- PD-4821: Eastbank receiving-door import. The file labels doors E1/E2 but the booking sheet uses 01/02. Needs fixing before any reimport, to avoid duplicates (#central-team, 9 Jun 2026).
- Pine Crossing: the appointment screen shows only the afternoon shift, so morning bookings can't be made. No ticket number in the channel (#central-team, 9 Jun 2026).
- Store rollout blockers from the 9 Jun escalation: three stores were listed only as "waiting" on the rollout tracker. Priyanka was collecting names, shift times and blockers from one receiving lead per store. I can't see her results.
- Moss's Central cheat sheet has a short Marrow Agrisupply note: "door 4 msg". No ticket or detail behind it.

Marrow Fieldworks
- Ticket #4409: recurring timeout on the Gatehouse Check-In report at the Salina North yard (Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron, 06:00 flatbed intake). Open as of Moss's 2 Jan digest.
- Ticket #4412: minor driver SMS prompt glitch when staging combine trailers on the unpaved overflow lots. Open as of the same digest.
- Account handoff to Marrow Fieldworks on 5 Jan 2026 (Moss digest). The digest describes #4409 and #4412 as "Pree's dealer account", which is my only link between those tickets and Fieldworks. The digest doesn't name the account directly, so please confirm.

I found no other Marrow tickets or feature requests in the channels or files I can see. Your #central-team thread (9 Jun) doesn't list a status for PD-4821 or Pine Crossing.

I posted the list in #central-team as a reply to your message.

It has five Marrow Agrisupply items and two Marrow Fieldworks tickets:
- **Marrow Agrisupply:** FR-882 (pallet-jack icons, sent to the Q2 backlog), PD-4821 (Eastbank door-label mismatch), the Pine Crossing morning-shift gap, the store rollout blockers from 9 June, and a "door 4 msg" note in Moss's cheat sheet.
- **Marrow Fieldworks:** tickets #4409 and #4412 from Moss's 2 January digest.

Three gaps to check before Thursday:
- The 2 January digest doesn't name the account for #4409 and #4412. It calls them "Pree's dealer account" and says the account hands to Marrow Fieldworks on 5 January. I've asked you to confirm.
- Nothing I can see is newer than June for the Agrisupply items, so their current status needs the tracker.
- I can't see Priyanka's store-by-store results from 9 June.
